### Moments of Praise
Author: Joe Holland
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/moments-of-praise
Passage: Psalm 117:1-2
Points:
- Believers often miss opportunities for worship by waiting for large blocks of uninterrupted time.
- The brevity of the psalm provides a biblical model for short, frequent bursts of praise throughout the day.
- Ordinary moments like daily commutes or evening routines can become meaningful occasions to extol God.
- Despite its shortness, the psalm presents rich Christ-centered theology and a vision for worldwide missions.

### The Self Interest of God (Psalm 117)
Author: Erik Raymond
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/erik-raymond/the-self-interest-of-god-psalm-117/
Passage: Psalm 117:1-2
Points:
- God rightly seeks His own glory and calls all people to acknowledge His supreme character.
- The summons to praise removes all national and racial barriers, extending to every people group on earth.
- Praise is rooted in two unchanging realities: God's steadfast lovingkindness and His eternal truth.
- Jesus likely sang these very words during the Last Supper before offering Himself for sinners.
- Grace rescues and transforms former enemies into grateful friends who eagerly celebrate God's greatness.
